ruling.recommended_action: Refund $8.35 to the rider as a Ryde voucher for the unexempted detour distance on this metered RydeTAXI trip; note the driver's RD-1 shortest-route breach on file.

segment_findings.reason: From ~12:12:35 the GPS trace leaves the quoted route (which continues south on the AYE corridor) and loops north-east to 1.3113,103.7675 before rejoining southbound. No traffic incident and no band-1/2 congestion on the replaced AYE segment (only SYN-1002 band 4 / SYN-1003 band 5), and no prior rider consent in chat, so no RD-4 or RD-5 exemption; RD-1 violation, extra_km chargeable under RD-2.

The trace then runs on a parallel road west of the quoted AYE alignment and swings into a second western lobe (1.2919–1.2928,103.7662–103.7683) while the quoted route runs at ~1.2929–1.2938,103.7840–103.7860, before returning to NUS. No incident/band evidence of a reasonable cause and no rider agreement to this change, so RD-4/RD-5 do not exempt; RD-1 violation, extra_km chargeable under RD-2.
